Validez: phone con guión en posición incorrecta (ej: 9-12345678) debe normalizarse.

```python
def clean_phone_bad_dash(df):
    cleaned = df.copy()
    ph = cleaned["phone"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
    bad_dash = ph.str.contains("-") & ~ph.str.fullmatch(r"\d{2}-\d{7}")
    digits = ph.str.replace(r"[^0-9]","",regex=True)
    mask = bad_dash & ph.ne("")
    cleaned.loc[mask, "phone"] = "9" + digits[mask].str.slice(-8).str.zfill(8)
    cleaned["flag_validez_phone_dash"] = mask
    return cleaned
# Normalizar phone con guión incorrecto
```

Validez: department con capitalización incorrecta (lima en vez de Lima) se corrige.

```python
def clean_department_case(df):
    cleaned = df.copy()
    valid = {"Lima","Arequipa","Trujillo","Cusco","Piura","Chiclayo","Huancayo","Iquitos","Tacna","Callao"}
    dept = cleaned["department"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
    title_case = dept.str.title()
    mask = dept.ne(title_case) & title_case.isin(valid)
    cleaned.loc[mask, "department"] = title_case[mask]
    cleaned["flag_validez_dept_case"] = mask
    return cleaned
# Capitalizar nombre de departamento correctamente
```

Exactitud: el campo balance debe poder convertirse a float. Si es texto no numérico, poner 0.

```python
def clean_nonnumeric_balance(df):
    cleaned = df.copy()
    bal_raw = cleaned["balance"].astype(str)
    bal_num = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["balance"], errors="coerce")
    mask = bal_num.isna() & bal_raw.str.strip().ne("") & bal_raw.str.strip().ne("nan")
    cleaned.loc[mask, "balance"] = 0.0
    cleaned["flag_exactitud_balance_texto"] = mask
    return cleaned
# balance debe ser numérico
```

Exactitud: avg_balance_90d de clientes nuevos (tenure < 0.25) no puede superar 3x su balance.

```python
def clean_new_customer_avg_balance(df):
    cleaned = df.copy()
    ten = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["tenure_years"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    bal = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["balance"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    avg = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["avg_balance_90d"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    mask = (ten < 0.25) & (avg > bal * 3)
    cleaned.loc[mask, "avg_balance_90d"] = bal[mask].round(2)
    cleaned["flag_exactitud_nuevo_avg_alto"] = mask
    return cleaned
# Cliente nuevo: avg_balance <= 3x balance
```

```python
def clean_segment_english_variants(df):
    cleaned = df.copy()
    seg = cleaned["segment"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    mapping = {"personal":"Mass","individual":"Mass","business":"Corporate",
               "corporate":"Corporate","premium":"Premium","standard":"Standard","basic":"Basic"}
    mask = seg.isin(mapping.keys()) & ~cleaned["segment"].isin({"Mass","Standard","Premium","Corporate","Basic"})
    cleaned.loc[mask, "segment"] = seg[mask].map(mapping)
    cleaned["flag_validez_seg_variante"] = mask
    return cleaned
# Normalizar variantes de segmento en inglés
```

```python
def clean_missing_avg_balance(df):
    cleaned = df.copy()
    ten = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["tenure_years"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    avg = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["avg_balance_90d"], errors="coerce")
    bal = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["balance"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    mask = (ten > 2.0) & avg.isna()
    cleaned.loc[mask, "avg_balance_90d"] = (bal[mask] * 0.9).round(2)
    cleaned["flag_completitud_avg_bal"] = mask
    return cleaned
# avg_balance_90d obligatorio para cuentas antiguas
```

Exactitud: balance Corporate mínimo es 10000, Premium mínimo es 1500. Corregir si está por debajo.

```python
def clean_min_balance_segment(df):
    cleaned = df.copy()
    bal = pd.to_numeric(cleaned["balance"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    seg = cleaned["segment"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
    corp = (seg == "Corporate") & (bal < 10000)
    prem = (seg == "Premium") & (bal < 1500)
    cleaned.loc[corp, "balance"] = 10000.0
    cleaned.loc[prem, "balance"] = 1500.0
    cleaned["flag_exactitud_min_balance"] = corp | prem
    return cleaned
# Dimensión: Exactitud | balance mínimo por segmento
```
